correctness.rationale: In the stated uniform-prior, two mirror-threshold, independent symmetric-bit-flip model, the three true-output regions [0,t),[t,1−t),[1−t,1] give p00=p11=(1−δ²+4δ²t)/4 and signed centered first moments ±δt(1−t)/2. Cross-output first moments vanish by symmetry. Total variance yields R=1/12−2δ²t²(1−t)²/(1−δ²+4δ²t). Differentiation reduces optimality to H=3δ²t²+(1−2δ²)t−(1−δ²)/2, with unique root in (1/3,1/2) for δ∈(0,1), root 1/3 at δ=1; δ=0 all designs tie. The implicit derivative is negative in δ². The boundary (δ,t)=(1,0) is separately constant-risk. Independent exact posterior integration matched eight rational parameter pairs, with endpoint limits and radical formula checked algebraically; no general non-symmetric optimum asserted.
